text:
Marta: Quick heads-up — running concurrency sweep for gpt-redwood-3-quant on runner-beta and seeing p95 spike around 128-160 concurrent. baseline p95 ~ 110ms, spike to ~520ms.
Kai: Do you see KV cache misses in the runner logs? That usually shows at those concurrencies.
Marta: Attached small excerpt from perf harness run (truncated):
```
concurrency,requests,p95_ms,cost_per_token
64,12000,112,0.000031
128,24000,118,0.000030
160,30000,520,0.000045
192,36000,540,0.000048
```
Marta: Also noticed a lot more small-idle slices in the runner dashboard, might be prefetch thrash.
Devon: Hmm. Which runner config? continuous_batching=false? prefetch=on?
Marta: Runner config snippet:
```
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 32
  window_ms: 12
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  max_prefetch: 4
kv_cache:
  mode: shared
```
Nora: Can you re-run with prefetch=false and batching.window_ms=8? Also tag the CI job so we have artifacts.
eng-ci-bot: CI job started: perf/eval-1845678901 — artifact link: https://ci.redwood.dev/perf/1845678901
sre-bot: FYI, allocated extra capacity in runner-beta for 10m to repro.
Kai: If disabling prefetch reduces p95, we might be hitting memory bandwidth contention with the int8 kernel. Devon, can you check kernel selection logs in the runner at the same time window?
Devon: On it. Also will add a metric to the harness: model_kernel_id and kernel_mem_bandwidth_mb to the CSV. We should surface cost_per_token and p95 in dashboard panel.
Marta: Thanks — logging the variant, run id, and seed. Will re-run now with prefetch off and attach results.
eng-ci-bot: perf/eval-1845678901 finished — artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/perf/1845678901/artifacts
Marta: Re-run results (short): p95 at 160 now 138ms, cost_per_token unchanged. Looks like prefetch was the culprit.
Nora: Great — can we add an automated CI check that fails the sweep if p95 increases >2.5x from baseline? Might catch regressions early.
Devon: I'll wire that into perf-ci: compare p95 to baseline stored in eval-db, threshold configurable.
Marta: Also adding a dashboard panel in console: sweep heatmap (concurrency vs p95) and annotation when prefetch toggled.
Kai: Sounds good. Follow-up: let's schedule a quick postmortem if this recurs across models.
Marta: SG — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
